semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical components for semiconductor packaging and testing, such as conductive adhesives and test sockets.
summary: Shenzhen Interposer Technology Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing electronic chip templates and conductive adhesives essential for semiconductor packaging and testing. Their products, including test sockets and burn-in test interposers, enhance the performance and reliability of semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Conductive adhesive solutions (e.g., gold neck conductive adhesives, random conductive adhesives)
Test sockets for QFN, BGA, and SOP packages
Burn-in test interposers for CPU, GPU, DDR, LPDDR, and FLASH memory devices
